findings.claim: All three findings from 207e7e6 are resolved. (1) closeLandedTask no longer accepts criteria. It attaches evidence and runs tm done as the authorized actor. When the store refuses, the landing stands and TOPOLOGY_INTEGRATE_UNCLOSED names each unaccepted criterion by index and text, and a rerun after they are accepted closes without merging again (test asserts accepted is [] and the criteria are untouched). (2) The close-retry at line 632 now runs integrationAuthority, the same caller and plan gate as the merge. A worker pane naming the lead (TM_DISPATCH_WORKER unset) and the lead with a revoked grant are both refused by name, and the task stays open. (3) One integrationAuthorization builder serves both paths. An operator-shell auto_merge PR integrate records authorized: false, and the test checks it field-for-field against the fast-forward path. The actor-mismatch check moved into the shared gate as a named 'caller' refusal. Guardrails from the prior round are unchanged: exactly --merge --match-head-commit with no bypass flags, named refusals before any merge, and idempotent handling of already-merged and unrecorded PRs. The range is TM-249's own files. The request includes no test output.
